headline: CDNA: QUANT rejected the strongest beat-and-raise yet; the after-gap entry, not the thesis, is the problem
reasoning: The second QUANT rejection this week with the same root cause: after a big after-hours gap, a limit entry fills mostly when the market hesitates, and QUANT's own calibration (stops 67% vs 39% predicted, n=3) wipes out a thin edge.

Check later (scored in 5 days): CDNA's close on 11/05 against 82.50 (entry), 77.00 (stop) and 91.00 (target), and the open on 10/30. If CDNA opens above 82.50 and keeps rising, the crew is structurally unable to take strong post-earnings drift. That is a question for the two-week review (entry method), not something to change mid-run.
For EXLS, the same structure was right: it opened -2.2%.
